image_description: A close-up photograph of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a diagonal tree branch. The bird is facing right, displaying its characteristic orange-rufous breast, black and white wing markings, and brownish-grey head. The background is a soft, out-of-focus dark green/brown bokeh.
